subject: Functions digit.fixed, build template and digitsurface no longer work for me since updating R and RStudio

messages.author: b035f47141cdf5b7
messages.subject: Functions digit.fixed, build template and digitsurface no longer work for me since updating R and RStudio
parts:
Hi geomorph community, 

This is my firs post to the community. I'm using geomorph to digitize fixed and semi-landmarks on juvenile clavicles to capture changes in clavicular shape. 

Here is my code to digitize my fixed and semi-landmarks: 

### NP075LClavicle is a Mesh 3D object
fixed.LeftNP075 <- digit.fixed(spec = NP075LClavicle, fixed = 7, index = FALSE, ptsize = 1, center = TRUE)
semi.LeftNP075 <- buildtemplate(spec = NP075LClavicle, fixed = fixed.LeftNP075, surface.sliders = 100)
digitsurface(spec = NP075LClavicle, fixed = fixed.LeftNP075) 

Previously, I never had an issue with this code. However, since updating to the latest version of both R and Rstudio, this code no longer works. I now encounter the following error message with both digit.fixed and digitsurface: "Error: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors".

I believe this errors is arising from my Mesh 3D object, but I'm not sure. 

Why is this error occurring and how can I fixed it? 

Thanks, 
Sean
